# documented subcommand groups exist with expected verbs (README Commands tables)

# auth subcommands
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input auth --help
stdout 'login'
stdout 'logout'
stdout 'status'

# config subcommands
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input config --help
stdout 'list'
stdout 'get'
stdout 'set'
stdout 'profile'

# config profile subcommands
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input config profile --help
stdout 'list'
stdout 'active'
stdout 'create'
stdout 'delete'
